# snipeit_manufacturer (Data Source)

Looks up a single manufacturer by `id` or exact `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_manufacturer" "apple" {
  name = "Apple"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the manufacturer. Set it to look up by id.
- `name` (String) Name of the manufacturer. Set it to look up by exact name.

### Read-Only

- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `support_email` (String) Support email address of the manufacturer.
- `support_phone` (String) Support phone number of the manufacturer.
- `support_url` (String) Support website of the manufacturer.
- `url` (String) Website of the manufacturer.
- `warranty_lookup_url` (String) Warranty lookup URL of the manufacturer.
